about_heading: More Than a Name in Your Inbox
about_para1: Church Of The Living God has been a spiritual home for families across Charlottesville — a small but mighty congregation rooted in prayer, worship, and the Word, where every message we receive gets a real reply from real people who care.
about_para2: Curious about the heart behind this church before you write to us? Here's where to start.
cta_para: There's always room at the table. Come worship with us this week and experience the warmth of our church family firsthand.
